title: fumaria agraria subsp. atlantica
intro: Fumaria agraria subsp. atlantica, commonly known as Atlas Fumitory, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Fumariaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in North Africa, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Fumaria agraria subsp. atlantica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Fumaria agraria subsp. atlantica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
